legend: Hyperkeratosis with scattered parakeratosis. Note the effacement of the epidermal rete ridges, with atypia of the basal layer cells.

legend: Prominent atypia of the basal layer, with variably sized nuclei and focal squamatization. The squamous cells show dysmaturation with a variable increase in size and pallor; the granular cell layer is retained.
